station_id.title: NWS Station ID
station_id.description: National Weather Service station ID (e.g., PHI for Philadelphia)

high_temp_threshold.title: High Temperature Threshold (°F)
high_temp_threshold.description: Temperature above which the high temp sensor will detect (sensor will show 'detected')

low_temp_threshold.title: Low Temperature Threshold (°F)
low_temp_threshold.description: Temperature below which the low temp sensor will detect (sensor will show 'detected')

check_interval.title: Check Interval (minutes)
check_interval.description: How often to check temperature forecast (minimum 15 minutes)
